segments.name: Oil and Gas Exploration and Development

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling oil produced from its wells to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: We have had revenue-generating operations since the McCool Ranch Oil Field (defined hereafter) was restarted on February 22, 2024, and recognized our first revenues in our fiscal quarter ended April 30, 2024

changes.text: In 2025 the company terminated operations at the McCool Ranch Oil Field and abandoned all related leases.
changes.evidence: On May 27, 2025, we executed a termination agreement with Trio LLC to end operations at the location and abandon all related leases.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired heavy oil assets in Saskatchewan from Novacor, which became its only active producing wells.
changes.evidence: All five of our currently active wells are in the newly acquired Novacor property.

changes.text: In 2025 the company expanded in Canada with a second project acquired from Capital Land.
changes.evidence: In November 2025, we expanded our presence with the acquisition of a second Canadian project from Capital Land (defined below).
